_about: The CVE identifiers each CISA cybersecurity advisory and analysis report page names, read from a maintainer-side copy of the page's text and never edited by hand. scripts/validate.py refuses a record whose every cited source is listed here and none of them names an identifier the record carries. `read` is the date the copy was taken; a page revised after it can name identifiers this list does not.
attribution: Identifiers read from pages published by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency at cisa.gov. Only the identifiers are carried; no advisory text is reproduced.
